question: Category of students shall not be eligible for inter college transfer
answer:
1. Students admitted under NRI/PIO quota.
2. Students admitted under TFW Scheme.
3. Students admitted in any supernumerary seats.
4. Students admitted in autonomous colleges.
5. Govt. of India Nominees.
6. Management Quota students in Aided colleges.
7. Management Quota students in private Self Financing Colleges.
8. Lateral Entry students.
9. Students admitted under any other category which are ineligible as per the conditions for admission prescribed by Govt. of Kerala/Govt. of India.

The document explicitly lists these categories of students as ineligible for inter college transfer.
